segments.text: Friends, the Omicron is rampant and we are all very concerned. I am speaking to you
to make you worry free with a very simple technique which you can use for yourself,
your friends, your family and all your loved ones. I have been using this for more than four or five
months and I have distributed about thousand packets of dried ginger which is also called
soint it's ginger powder to these people what you have to do is you have to take a bit of this
can you see this on my finger put it in your nostril snot put it in the other nostril snot
I do it every morning and evening. The reason is very scientific. Dry ginger is
highly alkaline and it has a high pH value. When you do it inside all the mucus
and the acid the infections which you have are all acidic and have low pH. They
get killed instantly. As you know the virus COVID and other virus travels
through the nostrils, through the mucus, into the throat and then possibly onto the lungs.
So from the nostril itself where we ingest it, if we take care of it, we'll be perfectly fine.
So please circulate this in the public interest to as many people as you can and benefit from it.
